==Description==
'''Sugar Rush''' is an event consumable that can be obtained from the [[Null & Void Event]] and formerly from the [[Hexscape Event]]. It can be used to support towers. It can be obtained from the [[Low Grade Crate]], [[Mid Grade Crate]] and [[High Grade Crate]].

Only up to three '''Sugar Rushes''' can be used by a player. It has a 45 second cooldown, but when first starting the match, the cooldown is set to 30.

==Usage==
When using '''Sugar Rush''', the player will start holding a chocolate bar, eating it if used. This will give towers a 60% [[Firerate Buff]] for between 10 and 30 seconds. After this, they will receive a 40% [[Fatigue Debuff]], which duration is half of the [[Firerate Buff]] duration.

==Appearance==
'''Sugar Rush''' is a chocolate bar inside an open red and white foil wrap.

==Strategy==
*This consumable is best used as a way to deal with enemies that you or your team may struggle with, as the firerate boost for all your towers will be helpful.
**However, the temporary firerate slowness effect applied to your towers after the effects ended makes this consumable situational at best, using this consumable will be mostly helpful when you or your team is dealing with a tough difficulty spike. Anything else outside of that could make you or your team lose the match, so use it wisely.
**If combining the '''Sugar Rush''' consumable with the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability and the [[Cooldown Flag]], the affected tower will be able to fire extremely fast and deal lots of DPS. This is most useful for fast-firing towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]].
***Any [[Firerate Buff]] of 40%, like the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability at Level 4 can completely nullify the [[Fatigue Debuff]] provided by the '''Sugar Rush''' consumable, but this will not grant any benefit to the towers apart from nullifying the buff unless other [[Firerate Buff]]s are applied to make it go past 40%.
